artworks.title: The Little Errand-Girl (Le petit trottin)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on China paper
artworks.description: The image depicts the upper body of two individuals in a stylized, illustrated format. The person on the left is shown in profile, facing to the right. They have short, wavy hair and are wearing a garment with a high collar and loose sleeves. The person on the right is shown more from the back, wearing a top hat and an overcoat, with only the lower portion of their face visible, including a mustache. This individual wears checkered pants. The background is blank, focusing attention on the accompanying text which reads "le petit trottin paroles de achille Melandri musique de désiré Dihau." The illustration is black on a white background with no additional scenery or objects.

artworks.medium: color lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows an abstract shape with sinuous lines on a textured brown background. The shape mixes pastel blues, greens, and yellows, resembling an elongated figure. Light and shadows create a dynamic visual, hinting at familiar forms like a bird's body.

artworks.title: Why Not?...Once Is Not a Habit (Pourquoi pas?...Une fois n'est pas coutume)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: This is an illustration of three individual busts in profile. The first individual, on the left, is a man wearing a top hat, displaying a prominent beard and mustache. The middle figure is facing the man and has short or upswept hair. The figure on the right appears to be female with a bun or updo hairstyle adorned with a feather and is wearing a high-collared garment. The background of the illustration has a light, sketchy texture.

artworks.title: Why Not?...Once Is Not a Habit (Pourquoi pas?...Une fois n'est pas coutume)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image portrays a sketch featuring the upper bodies and profiles of three individuals. Two men and one woman are depicted. The first man, on the left, wears a tall hat, frontal nose and beard. The woman in the center has short, wavy hair. The second man, on the right, has short hair and a pointed nose, and is wearing a coat with visible buttons on the sleeves. Faint pencil lines suggest the presence of a feather atop his head. The background is plain.

artworks.title: At the Varieties: Mlle. Lender et Brasseur (Aux variétiés: Mlle. Lender et Brasseur)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch with two figures, one on the right and one on the left. On the right, part of one figure's upper torso and arm is visible, with the arm reaching upwards. The figure appears to be facing slightly to the left, with hair sketched in short strokes. The facial features are only outlined. On the left, another figure's head and shoulders are depicted, with faint facial features and lines suggesting a reclining position. The figures lack detailed clothing or accessories. The backdrop is sparse, with speckles and smudged areas creating a textured effect across the top of the image. Below the figures, handwritten French text is present in the lower portion of the image.

artworks.title: En quarante
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image features two individuals depicted from the waist up. The person on the left is seated with their body turned slightly towards the other person, while the individual on the right is leaning back. Both appear relaxed, with the person on the left having delicate facial features, closed or downcast eyes, and curly hair peeking out from under a wide-brimmed hat. They are wearing a high-collared garment. The person on the right has a prominent, rounded face with a thick mustache and is wearing a top hat. The background is minimal, with a plain surface and a drink in a glass placed on the table in front of them.

artworks.title: Mlle. Lender and Baron (Mlle. Lender et Baron)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing the upper bodies of two individuals. The person on the left is positioned slightly in profile and appears to be facing the person on the right. This person has a leaning posture with a large top hat on their head. The second person, located to the right, is also shown primarily from the upper torso upwards, and their head is slightly tilted. They have distinct facial features with eyes prominently drawn and lips pursed. Their hair is styled with an elaborate adornment that fans upwards and outwards. The clothing of the person on the right appears to be detailed with broad shoulders and possibly a high neckline. The person on the left is holding a cane. The sketched background is minimal, comprised mostly of shading behind the subjects and extending to the upper right, with several indistinct markings that suggest texture but do not depict specific objects.

artworks.title: Dress Rehearsal at the Folies-Bergere (Répétition générale aux Folies-Bergère)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: The image depicts two individuals dancing. The person on the left is in a semi-profile facing right, with their head slightly turned towards the second person. This person has a delicate hairstyle and is wearing a long dress and boots. The second individual, on the right, is facing left, with short, curly hair. They are wearing a dark outfit. The background is a dark textured surface with indistinct shapes, suggesting a theatrical indoor setting.

artworks.title: Dress Rehearsal at the Folies-Bergere (Répétition générale aux Folies-Bergère)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black

The person on the left is standing, in an animated position, with their face turned toward the other figure. They have short hair. The other person has curly or wavy hair. The visible figure wears a flowing dress or coat, suggesting fabric texture and movement. The setting is dark and sketchy, with a mysterious atmosphere, possibly an interior scene with indistinct shadows in the background. There is a mark or signature at the bottom left. artworks.title: Folies-Bergere: The Censors of M. Prudhomme (Folies-Bergère: Les pudeurs de M. Prudhomme)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people in a dynamic full-body scene. Two women are dressed in light-colored garments with dark collars and styled hair. They are dancing with a man wearing a suit and bow tie, leaning backwards. In the background, there is a standing figure that appears almost ghostly, to the left. The setting is a wooden floor with a textured and shaded background, giving a sense of a dim interior space. The figures are illustrated in a sketch-like manner.

artworks.title: At the Renaissance: Sarah Bernhardt in "Phedre" (A la Renaissance: Sarah Bernhardt dans "Phèdre")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows two figures from the waist up in a closely connected pose. The upper figure is facing slightly to the left, with their face slightly turned and eyes looking upward. Their hair is covered with a veiling drapery, and they are wearing a garment adorned with circular motifs. The lower figure is positioned below the upper one, with more pronounced facial features and deep-set eyes. They are wearing a wrap or garment that drapes around their head and shoulders. One of their hands is visible, appearing to be holding the upper figure's hand. The background is minimally detailed, shaded with arcs suggesting a shadowy environment.

artworks.description: The image shows two individuals engaged in conversation. The man on the left is shown in profile, wearing a cap and jacket. The woman on the right faces him, holding a lantern or lamp. They are depicted in a sparsely decorated interior with dim lighting and shadows.

artworks.title: At the Opera: Mme. Caron in "Faust" (A l'opéra: Mme. Caron dans "Faust")
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in a theater or stage setting. The central figure is positioned facing forward with a stern expression and closed, thin lips. They have stylized hair and wear a dress with puffed sleeves. To their left, a second person wears a large brimmed hat and puffed shorts. They look towards the central figure with an open mouth. Behind them, a third person stands in a contrapposto stance with a hand on their hip. The background is textured and monochromatic with abstract shadowy forms suggesting depth or an interior location.

artworks.title: Lugne Poe and Baldy in "Au-dessus des forces humaines" (Lugne Poe et Baldy dans "Au-desses des forces humaines")

She has a softly drawn facial profile, and her hair is cropped close to her head. She wears a long-sleeved dress with a high collar. The woman on the right stands with her arms raised and hands clasped behind her head. Her facial features are less distinct, and she wears a long-sleeved dress. The background is minimal, with faintly sketched structural elements.

artworks.title: Mlle. Lender in "Madame Satan" (Mlle. Lender dans "Madame Satan")

The person on the left is in a three-quarter pose, turned slightly towards the figure on the right, with their head turned to the side. This person has delicate facial features and their hair appears to be styled up. They are wearing a garment with puffed shoulders and a prominent black, circular feature at the neckline. The person on the right is standing facing forward but slightly turned towards the left figure. This figure also has delicate features, with their head slightly raised. They are dressed in a jacket with structured shoulders and a high collar. Both individuals appear to be interacting, with soft and loose lines suggesting movement. The background is lightly textured and splattered paper.

The other individual is less defined, wearing a draped garment. In the background, there is a wall with subtle shading and some vague shapes. The person on the right is facing slightly towards the left and appears to be standing as well. Only the outline of their facial features and hair can be seen. Their jacket has a subtle point indicating that their hands might be behind their back. The background features faint lines that could depict a window or frame with a table or desk on the left side, on top of which rests a few indistinct objects.
